id: title:dmarchuk:skip the attio upsert when the person has no email

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a guard clause and corresponding unit test to the Attio connector workflow, preventing Hog query execution when an email parameter is missing. This could improve reliability by avoiding downstream API calls or processing errors in the connector, though the connector's actual production use and the specific impact of this guard are not established by the code alone.
review.reason: Adds a guard clause checking for empty email input before Hog query execution and a corresponding unit test, returning early with a print statement if no email is set. This could prevent downstream API calls or processing errors when an email parameter is missing, potentially improving reliability of the Attio connector workflow.
